sector_manifest.selection_rule: For each frozen T2A source choose the shortest available official FFI cadence tier among ordinary sector IDs 1..200, then the earliest sector in that tier.
sector_manifest.reason_for_exclusion: No source needs the nonstandard sector entry to achieve its shortest ordinary cadence tier; exclusion is frozen before TESSCut data retrieval.

abc_selection.b_rule: Among all eligible consecutive A/B/C triples, select the B cadence whose TIME is closest to the median finite TIME in the selected sector; ties break by lower B row index.
abc_selection.a_rule: Immediate preceding row of frozen B.
abc_selection.c_rule: Immediate following row of frozen B.
abc_selection.why_cadence_native: TESS FFI cadence differs from LUCI/ZTF timing. The independent TESS test asks whether a preselected central cadence is isolated relative to its immediate neighbors, without tuning B to pixel brightness or forcing the original asymmetric time offsets.

success_semantics.PASS_PREPOINTED_CADENCE_MANIFEST_COMPLET: All 42 frozen sources produce one TESSCut file and one metadata-only quality-qualified A/B/C cadence triple.
success_semantics.BLOCKED_PREPOINTED_CADENCE_MANIFEST_INCO: At least one frozen source cannot produce a valid metadata-only A/B/C triple; no T3B pixel claim may be made for it.
